question: Which dancer was the first person from Odisha to get Padma Vibhushan in 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra,** renowned **Odissi dancer**.
 
• Received **Padma Vibhushan in 2000**.
 
• First person from Odisha to **receive this honour**.
 
• Pioneered **Odissi dance form**.
 
• Widely acclaimed for his contributions to **Indian classical dance**.
 
• Recognized for his **mastery of Odissi dance technique and choreography**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Shyama Charan Pati**

 
 
• Renowned **Odissi dancer and guru**.
 
• Played a crucial role in the **Odissi dance revival movement**.
 
• Known for impeccable **technique and graceful movements**.
 
• Established the **Shyamahari Dance Foundation**.
 
• Received prestigious awards, including the **Padma Shri**(1990).
 
 
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh**
 
 
• Renowned **Manipuri dance exponent**.
 
• Dedicated to preserving and promoting **Manipuri dance and culture**.
 
• Known for a profound understanding of **Manipuri dance traditions**.
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh **won the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award **in **1967 **for his work in **Manipuri dance**.
 
 
 
• **Guru Mayadhar Rout**
 
 
• Renowned **Odissi dancer, choreographer, and teacher**.
 
• Played a pivotal role in **Odissi dance revival**.
 
• Trained under **Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**.
 
• Known for technical prowess and expressive abilities.
 
• Established **Odisha Dance Academy**, **training many students**.
 
• **Guru Mayadhar Rout **was awarded the **Padma Shri **in **2004 **for his work in **Odissi dance**.
